5-day-fly-in-serengeti-wildebeest-migrat.t: 5-Day Migration Safari by Air: Arusha to the Northern Serengeti
5-day-fly-in-serengeti-wildebeest-migrat.o: Skip the long road transfers and take a light aircraft from Arusha straight to the northern plains, where the herds gather at the Mara River between July and October. You stay in camps placed close to the crossing points, spend your days on guided game drives, and look for big cats among the wildebeest and zebra.
h: Scenic flight from Arusha to the northern Serengeti
Camps close to the Mara River crossings
Lion, leopard and cheetah on the herd routes
Most of your time spent on game drives, not on the road

7-day-mara-river-crossing-safari-the-gre.t: 7-Day Safari to the Mara River Crossings
7-day-mara-river-crossing-safari-the-gre.o: A full week built around the most dramatic moment of the migration, when thousands of animals plunge into the crocodile-filled Mara River. After the southern parks you move north with the herds and give the crossings enough time to be seen properly rather than squeezed into a single afternoon.
h: Several days in the north for the best chance of a crossing
Tarangire and Ngorongoro on the way
Guides who read the herds and the river
Lodge or camp nights, depending on your budget

3-day-great-migration-river-crossing-saf.t: 3-Day Mara River Migration Trip from Zanzibar
3-day-great-migration-river-crossing-saf.o: Three short days for beach travellers who want to see the migration without losing a week. You fly in from Zanzibar, spend your time with the herds near the Mara River and fly back to the coast, with the logistics handled for you.
h: Two nights close to the herds
Guided game drives in an open-roof 4x4
Easy add-on to a beach holiday

8-day-great-migration-calving-season-saf.o: From January to March the southern plains fill with newborn wildebeest and the predators that follow them. This eight-day midrange itinerary pairs the calving grounds with Tarangire and the Ngorongoro Crater and keeps the pace relaxed, with comfortable lodges each night.
h: Newborn wildebeest and hunting cats near Ndutu
A full morning inside Ngorongoro Crater

4-day-ndutu-calving-season-safari-great-.t: 4-Day Ndutu Calving Safari with Ngorongoro Crater
4-day-ndutu-calving-season-safari-great-.o: A compact trip for the calving months. You spend time among the herds on the Ndutu plains, then descend into Ngorongoro Crater for a day with some of the densest wildlife in Tanzania. It suits travellers who want both highlights in under a week.
h: Calving herds on the Ndutu plains
A day in the Ngorongoro Crater
Short enough to fit into a long weekend away

3-day-zanzibar-to-serengeti-fly-in-and-f.t: 3-Day Calving Safari from Zanzibar by Air
3-day-zanzibar-to-serengeti-fly-in-and-f.o: Fly from the Indian Ocean to the Serengeti plains, watch the calving season at close range and be back on the beach in three days. Light aircraft keep road time to a minimum, so nearly every hour is spent with wildlife.
h: Flights from Zanzibar to the Serengeti and back
Calving herds and the cats that hunt them

6-day-tanzania-wildebeest-calving-safari.t: 6-Day Calving Season Route: Ndutu, Serengeti and Ngorongoro
6-day-tanzania-wildebeest-calving-safari.o: Six days that follow the herds across the southern Serengeti during the calving months. Time at Ndutu, the central plains and the crater gives you open grassland, kopjes and a caldera floor in a single, well-paced loop.
h: Central Serengeti kopjes and big cats

8-day-lake-natron-and-mara-river-migrati.t: 8-Day Safari: Lake Natron and the Mara River
8-day-lake-natron-and-mara-river-migrati.o: This route combines a remote, little-visited corner of the north, the salt lake of Natron beneath the volcano Ol Doinyo Lengai, with the migration river crossings further west. It rewards travellers who want landscape variety as well as wildlife.
h: Lake Natron and its flamingo-fringed shores
Quiet corners away from the main circuit

7-day-ndutu-calving-season-serengeti-and.t: 7-Day Calving Safari with a Lake Eyasi Cultural Visit
7-day-ndutu-calving-season-serengeti-and.o: Wildlife and people in one week. You follow the calving herds across Ndutu and the Serengeti, then spend a day around Lake Eyasi meeting communities who still live by hunting and gathering, led by local hosts.
h: Calving season on the Ndutu plains
A day with Hadzabe and Datoga communities at Lake Eyasi
Ngorongoro Crater on the way back

1-day-fly-in-and-fly-out-mikumi-national.t: Mikumi Day Safari by Air from Zanzibar
1-day-fly-in-and-fly-out-mikumi-national.o: A same-day escape from the coast. You fly to Mikumi, spend the day on game drives across its floodplain, and fly back to Zanzibar in the evening, with a guide, vehicle and park fees organised in advance.
h: Full day of game drives in Mikumi
Back on the island by evening

1-day-ngorongoro-crater-safari-from-arus.t: Ngorongoro Crater Private Day Trip from Arusha
1-day-ngorongoro-crater-safari-from-arus.o: One long day with a private vehicle and guide. You leave Arusha early, drive up to the rim and spend the morning on the crater floor before a picnic lunch beside the water and the road back in the afternoon.
h: Picnic lunch inside the conservation area
Back in Arusha for the evening

1-day-tarangire-national-park-short-safa.t: Tarangire Private Day Safari from Arusha
1-day-tarangire-national-park-short-safa.o: Tarangire is close enough to Arusha for a single day and rich enough to feel worth it. Expect elephant herds, ancient baobabs and a picnic lunch under a tree, all in your own vehicle with a guide.

1-day-tarangire-national-park-joining-sa.t: Tarangire Shared Day Safari from Arusha
1-day-tarangire-national-park-joining-sa.o: The budget way to see Tarangire. You travel in a shared vehicle with a small group and a driver-guide, with entry fees and lunch covered, and return to Arusha in the late afternoon.

2-day-fly-in-fly-out-zanzibar-to-mikumi-.t: 2-Day Mikumi Safari by Air from Zanzibar
2-day-fly-in-fly-out-zanzibar-to-mikumi-.o: A relaxed two-day trip with a night in a lodge near the park. You have an afternoon and a full morning on game drives in Mikumi, which is long enough to enjoy it without rushing, then fly back to the island.
h: Good value for a short break

2-day-tarangire-and-ngorongoro-crater-sa.t: 2-Day Tarangire and Crater Safari from Zanzibar
2-day-tarangire-and-ngorongoro-crater-sa.o: For beach travellers with only two days to spare. You fly to Arusha, spend the day in Tarangire, sleep at a lodge and descend into the Ngorongoro Crater the next morning before flying back to Zanzibar.

7-day-northern-tanzania-midrange-safari.o: A classic first safari at a comfortable price. Tarangire, Lake Manyara, two nights in the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater, driven in a private 4x4 and staying in mid-range lodges chosen for their location.
h: Four national parks in one week

7-day-northern-circuit-luxury-tanzania-s.t: 7-Day Luxury Northern Circuit: Drive In, Fly Out
7-day-northern-circuit-luxury-tanzania-s.o: A premium take on the Northern Circuit. You drive through Tarangire, Manyara and the Ngorongoro highlands to the Serengeti and then fly out from the Seronera airstrip, saving a full day of road travel at the end of the trip.
h: Scenic flight out of the Serengeti
Time to enjoy the properties, not just pass through

6-day-northern-tanzania-midrange-safari-.t: 6-Day Midrange Safari: Manyara, Serengeti and the Crater
6-day-northern-tanzania-midrange-safari-.o: Six days that skip the busiest stops and spend more time where it counts. Lake Manyara, a long stretch in the Serengeti and a full crater day, in a private 4x4 with pop-up roof.

6-day-tanzania-budget-safari-tarangire-s.t: 6-Day Budget Camping Safari: Tarangire, Serengeti, Crater
6-day-tanzania-budget-safari-tarangire-s.o: Wildlife on a tight budget. You sleep in basic camps, eat meals prepared by your cook and still get the headline parks: Tarangire, two days in the Serengeti and a morning inside Ngorongoro Crater.
h: Camping in or near each park
Meals prepared by your camp crew

9-day-tanzania-safari-lake-eyasi-and-kil.t: 9-Day Safari with Lake Eyasi and Kilimanjaro Foothills
9-day-tanzania-safari-lake-eyasi-and-kil.o: A longer trip that mixes game drives with time among people and landscape. Besides the main parks, you visit communities around Lake Eyasi and walk in the green foothills of Kilimanjaro before heading home.
h: Walks on the slopes of Kilimanjaro

10-day-great-wildebeest-migration-cultur.t: 10-Day Migration, Culture and Soda Lake Journey
10-day-great-wildebeest-migration-cultur.o: Our most complete northern itinerary. Lake Natron, the northern and central Serengeti, the Ngorongoro Crater, Lake Eyasi cultures and the Kilimanjaro foothills fit into ten days, in lodges, with a guide who stays with you throughout.
h: Lake Natron and the Rift Valley edge
Cultural visits and a foothills walk

5-day-serengeti-and-ngorongoro-classic-m.o: The two big names without the extras. Two Serengeti nights and a Ngorongoro crater day at midrange lodges, with a chance to see the migration depending on the season.

4-day-fly-in-fly-out-serengeti-safari.t: 4-Day Serengeti Safari by Air from Zanzibar
4-day-fly-in-fly-out-serengeti-safari.o: A fast Serengeti break for travellers staying on the coast. You fly in and out, spend three days on game drives and avoid the long road transfers that eat into a short trip.

3-days-affordable-joining-safari-tanzani.t: 3-Day Shared Safari: Tarangire, Manyara and Ngorongoro
3-days-affordable-joining-safari-tanzani.o: A short, budget-friendly safari on fixed departures from Arusha. You share the vehicle with other travellers, stay two nights in lodges and cover three parks in three days.

4-days-shared-safari-tanzania-2026-2027.t: 4-Day Shared Safari on the Northern Circuit
4-days-shared-safari-tanzania-2026-2027.o: An extra day over the 3-day trip gives more time in each park. You travel with a small group on a set departure date and split the costs of the vehicle and guide.

5-day-shared-group-camping-safari-tanzan.t: 5-Day Group Camping Safari on the Northern Circuit
5-day-shared-group-camping-safari-tanzan.o: Five days of camping with other travellers. You spend a night in Tarangire, two in the Serengeti and one on the Ngorongoro crater rim before a final morning in the crater, in public campsites with meals cooked by your crew.

3-day-tanzania-small-group-safari-sereng.o: A short trip that goes straight to the headline parks. Two nights in the Serengeti and a crater day, in a shared vehicle with a small group.

2-day-tarangire-and-ngorongoro-joining-s.o: Two days from Arusha for travellers short on time. A full day in Tarangire, one night at a lodge and the Ngorongoro Crater the next morning before returning.

ngorongoro-day-trip-joining-safari-tanza.t: Ngorongoro Crater Shared Day Trip from Arusha
ngorongoro-day-trip-joining-safari-tanza.o: A budget crater visit with fixed departures. Shared 4x4, an English-speaking guide, a picnic lunch and an evening return to Arusha.

3-day-lake-natron-adventure-and-oldoinyo.t: 3-Day Lake Natron and Ol Doinyo Lengai Trek (Shared)
3-day-lake-natron-adventure-and-oldoinyo.o: A tough, memorable trip for hikers. You travel to the Rift Valley, visit Lake Natron and its waterfalls, and make a night climb of the volcano Ol Doinyo Lengai, the Mountain of God.

mount-meru-hiking-safari-via-momella-gat.t: Mount Meru Hike from Momella Gate (Shared)
mount-meru-hiking-safari-via-momella-gat.o: Climb Tanzania's second-highest mountain with a ranger and a guide. The route starts at Momella Gate in Arusha National Park, where you may see giraffe and buffalo on the first day, and ends at the summit at dawn.

4-day-mount-meru-hiking-safari-via-momel.t: 4-Day Mount Meru Climb from Momella Gate (Shared)
4-day-mount-meru-hiking-safari-via-momel.o: Four days on Mount Meru, with camps in huts on the mountain and an early start for the summit ridge. Ideal as a first high-altitude trek.

4-day-usambara-mountains-hiking-and-cult.t: 4-Day Usambara Mountains Walking and Village Stay
4-day-usambara-mountains-hiking-and-cult.o: Cooler air, terraced hillsides and viewpoints over the plains. You walk between villages in the Usambara range, meeting local families and trying the food and farming of the highlands.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.t: 5-Day Kilimanjaro Climb on the Marangu Route
5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.o: The hut route, with beds and a gradual ascent, in five days. It is the shortest option on the mountain, so summit success is lower than on longer routes, and it suits fit walkers who are comfortable with altitude.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climb-via-umbwe-.o: The steepest and most direct route to the top, for experienced trekkers who want a challenge and accept a faster rate of altitude gain.

7-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.o: A scenic western approach through rainforest and across the Shira Plateau. Seven days gives time to acclimatise and a good chance of reaching the summit.

6-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.o: The popular Whiskey Route in six days, with varied scenery and a steady climb. It suits fit trekkers with good stamina.

7-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.o: The same route with an extra night at Karanga Camp, which gives your body more time to adjust to altitude before the summit push.
h: Higher summit success than six days

6-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.o: A steep western route with an extra night at Karanga Camp, which makes it more forgiving than the five-day option.

7-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.o: The only route approaching from the north, close to the Kenyan border. It is drier, quieter and gentler at the start, with views of the Mawenzi peak.

9-day-mount-kilimanjaro-trekking-adventu.o: The longest route on the mountain, circling the northern slopes before the summit. The slow pace gives the best acclimatisation and the highest success rate.

8-day-mount-kilimanjaro-trekking-adventu.o: A well-paced western route with two nights on the Shira Plateau and an extended walk to acclimatise, giving a strong chance of reaching the summit.

8-day-luxury-tanzania-safari-zanzibar-be.t: 8-Day Luxury Safari with a Zanzibar Beach Finish
8-day-luxury-tanzania-safari-zanzibar-be.o: Luxury lodges across the Northern Circuit followed by days on Zanzibar's beaches. A private guide takes you through Tarangire, the Serengeti and Ngorongoro before you fly to the coast to rest.

4-day-midrange-private-safari.o: A short, private trip through Tarangire, the Serengeti and Ngorongoro, with midrange lodges and your own vehicle.

6-day-family-tour-tanzania-2026-2027.t: 6-Day Family Safari: Manyara, Serengeti and Crater
6-day-family-tour-tanzania-2026-2027.o: A family-friendly route with shorter drives, lodges that welcome children and a guide who adapts the day to younger travellers.

7-day-ndutu-zanzibar-honeymoon-safari-20.o: A romantic split between the wild and the sea. Game drives across Ndutu and Ngorongoro, then a flight to Zanzibar for a few quiet days on the beach.

5-day-tanzania-christmas-safari-2026.o: Spend the holidays with elephants and lions. A private five-day trip through Tarangire, the Serengeti and Ngorongoro with festive touches at the lodges.

6-day-tanzania-new-year-holiday-safari-2.o: See in the new year on the Northern Circuit. Six days through three parks with lodge nights and a private vehicle.

7-day-tanzania-family-safari-adventure.o: A relaxed week for families through Tarangire, Manyara, the Serengeti and Ngorongoro, with reduced prices for children.

10-day-tanzania-honeymoon-safari-zanziba.o: Seven nights on safari and three on the beach. Romantic lodges in the parks and a quiet stay on Zanzibar to end the trip.

8-day-fly-out-luxury-tanzania-safari-zan.t: 8-Day Luxury Safari with Flight to Zanzibar
8-day-fly-out-luxury-tanzania-safari-zan.o: Premium camps in the Serengeti and Ngorongoro, followed by a flight to Zanzibar for beach time.

6-day-midrange-tanzania-safari.o: A balanced six-day trip through Tarangire, the Serengeti and Ngorongoro, at comfortable lodges.

6-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.t: 6-Day Kilimanjaro Climb on the Marangu Route
6-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.o: Six days on the hut route, with beds each night and an extra day to adapt to altitude before the summit.

4-day-luxury-tanzania-safari.o: A short, comfortable safari for travellers who want premium lodges and the Serengeti in four days, flying back to Arusha at the end.

5-day-luxury-wildebeest-migration-safari.o: Five days focused on the Serengeti herds, with high-end camps that follow the migration and a private guide.

7-day-luxury-big-five-wildebeest-migrati.t: 7-Day Luxury Big Five and Migration Safari
7-day-luxury-big-five-wildebeest-migrati.o: Look for all five of the big game species and the migration in a week, staying in top camps throughout.

4-day-luxury-serengeti-hot-air-balloon-s.t: 4-Day Luxury Serengeti Safari with Balloon Flight
4-day-luxury-serengeti-hot-air-balloon-s.o: A short premium trip that includes a sunrise hot air balloon over the plains.

6-day-luxury-great-migration-river-cross.o: Stay in the northern Serengeti where the herds cross the Mara River, in upscale camps with a private guide.

5-day-midrange-migration-safari.o: A five-day trip following the herds at midrange prices, with comfortable lodges and a private vehicle.

3-day-serengeti-hot-air-balloon-safari.o: A short Serengeti safari that includes a sunrise hot air balloon ride across the plains.

5-day-midrange-serengeti-ngorongoro-safa.t: 5-Day Midrange Safari: Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater
5-day-midrange-serengeti-ngorongoro-safa.o: Two big names in five days. Midrange lodges, a private vehicle and a full day on the crater floor.

10-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-via-le.t: 10-Day Kilimanjaro Climb via Lemosho with Daylight Summit
10-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-via-le.o: A slow western route timed so you reach the summit area in daylight, with extra acclimatisation along the way.

10-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-via-no.t: 10-Day Kilimanjaro Northern Circuit with Daylight Summit
10-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-via-no.o: The longest route, timed for a daylight summit and a slow rise through the northern slopes.

1-day-kilimanjaro-day-hike-via-lemosho-r.t: Kilimanjaro Day Hike on the Lemosho Route
1-day-kilimanjaro-day-hike-via-lemosho-r.o: A single day on the mountain's western slopes, through forest and moorland, for those who want a taste without committing to a climb.
